profile.name: VISA通信传输层
profile.description: 基于 pyVISA 的通用 VISA 通信软件组件，用于通过 GPIB、RS232、USB 或以太网与实验仪器建立会话并收发数据。本身不是具体的物理实验设备，而是面向多种仪器的通信接口层。
profile.description_en: A generic VISA communication software component based on pyVISA, used to open sessions and exchange data with laboratory instruments over GPIB, RS232, USB, or Ethernet. It is not a specific physical lab device, but a communication layer for many kinds of instruments.

registry.name: National Instruments Visa
registry.description: Visa是由National Instruments (VISA)生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、写入数据、初始化、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, query等操作。
